name: iEarn yUSDT hard-coded iUSDC accounting mismatch
summary: The immutable yUSDT runtime hard-coded Fulcrum's iUSDC market while treating assetBalanceOf() as USDT in its pool-value calculation. The attacker minted iUSDC to the vault, inflating the USDT-denominated share price, then used deposit and withdraw calls to create unbacked yUSDT and extract assets through the Curve yPool; the next block repeated the same defect against a sibling yUSDT deployment connected to the BUSD pool.

loss.notes: The USD total is the attacker cluster's exact net holdings after both defect executions, settlement and consolidation: six stablecoins valued at par plus 507.550988138411541129 WETH valued at the Chainlink ETH/USD answer of $1,920.14 updated at timestamp 1681365347. It excludes all repaid flash-loan principal. Gross victim depletion is not used because the campaign routes assets through two yUSDT deployments, Curve pools, Aave and an attacker helper, making the independently observable net proceeds the cleaner quantity.

ageReset.description: The target is a non-proxy direct contract. Its immutable runtime hashes identically at deployment and immediately before the exploit. The wrong Fulcrum market is present in constructor state at deployment, no set_new_FULCRUM transaction occurs before the exploit, and ownership was later renounced without changing it.

sources.note: Anchor 0xd55e43c1602b28d4fd4667ee445d570c8f298f5401cf04e62ec329759ecda95d is the first successful defect execution: its trace directly calls deposit, withdraw and rebalance on yUSDT 0x83f798e925bcd4017eb265844fddabb448f1707d. The next block's transaction 0x8db0ef33024c47200d47d8e97b0fcfc4b51de1820dfb4e911f0e3fb0a4053138 repeats the same mismatch on sibling yUSDT 0xe6354ed5bc4b393a5aad09f21c46e101e692d447, so the first deployment is the representative target and the loss covers the whole campaign. The official pinned source hard-codes 0xF013406A0B1d544238083DF0B93ad0d2cBE0f65f, Fulcrum iUSDC, into a yUSDT vault and includes its assetBalanceOf(address(this)) in USDT pool value. Live getters and storage retain that address through the exploit. The representative runtime hash is 0x2cf55112ca4a2e42573b6e4a17b3f5dbe3bad9935f045ec14b56ba136d0589ed both at deployment block 9465216 and pre-exploit block 17036778; its 3,669 top-level transactions include no set_new_FULCRUM call, and the owner is zero before the exploit. Its creation is transaction 0x947dfc6f73cccba391f2eb3fce5bc3be87bea3727ba5a23425f9f44db7f74d7a at 9465216:81, timestamp 1581470508, making code age 99,894,647 seconds. The sibling has the same wrong getter value but distinct runtime and is intentionally not a second target under the representative same-chain sibling-deployment rule. For loss, balances attributable to the attacker cluster after settlement 0xee6ac7e16ec8cb0a70e6bae058597b11ec2c764601b4cb024dec28d766fe88b2 and consolidation 0x3755f81d15d1dfd7257240d1858fd3b6e960ea1d1d68f3ff31d18600f697bb4e sum to 3,032,142.156139043816254804 DAI, 2,782,771.35525 USDC, 1,501,781.66894 USDT, 1,512,528.387000053792916917 TUSD, 1,785,091.038104302846317121 BUSD, 61,000.719448240129881728 USDP and 507.550988138411541129 WETH after excluding repaid flash liquidity. Chainlink ETH/USD 0x5f4ec3df9cbd43714fe2740f5e3616155c5b8419 returned 192014000000 with updatedAt 1681365347 at block 17036829; stablecoin par plus $1,920.14 per WETH gives $11,649,884.27924573.
